example.title: Harp Creek Bridge, State Highway 7 over Harp Creek

brief: State-highway open-spandrel reinforced-concrete deck arch of 1928, a 65 ft arch with a short deck-girder approach span at each end: two slender arch ribs carry the deck on thin spandrel columns, the approach spans sit on column bents, and the railing is a concrete parapet pierced by a row of small round-arched openings between posts. Bronze plaque on an end post names the creek, the arch contractor, the state highway department and 1928; black-and-white striped end markers. Two-lane highway through wooded hill country over a brushy creek.
